choices. Parent and conditional queries must remain separate. Exact enumeration
of original inputs and algebra are the comparators; solver success and test counts
cannot establish accounting validity. Resource exhaustion and unresolved obligations
prevent exact certification; failed checks trigger local repair.

reconstruction/adapter, tests and checker. Run P04 tests, P03 regression and the
